title: Gets me out the door in one piece
body: I've been using this for a few years now and basically, as someone with ADHD I rely on this app to get out the door in the morning. Sometimes I'm still late but the app tells me by how much so I know which bus I'm taking. I used to forget steps of my routine (or my lunch) all the time, but far less often now. Can be as low pressure as you want it to be. There are certainly many other uses I haven't tried.

title: So Good
body:
This is a awesome app. I love planing out my day and seeing how long it will take me all together. I also love that you don’t NEED the premium version to enjoy it.

The only down side I find rafter using it for a bit is that you can only have two routines at a time, this have led to the app being more of a planing app were I make a new plan every day, than really helping me creep a routine.

I totally understand that you need to have a premium version, but if you made it so I can have maybe five routines at a time whit the normal version I would really enjoy using the app for its true purpose. 
I really, really love this app and I look forward to using it in the future, hopefully with more routines available or maybe I someday will by premium😊
